name: linux-auditd
description: The kernel counts discarded records in audit_lost, readable via 'auditctl -s' and emitted to dmesg by audit_log_lost() — NOT into /var/log/audit/audit.log. The msg=audit(ts:serial) serial is not a gap-detecting sequence over the delivered file. No integrity binding by default. The loaded ruleset is real coverage information and is not in the log. Closest of the four to L2: the counter exists and is simply on the wrong side of the boundary.

independence.boundary_statement: The kernel writes it and an unprivileged process cannot. A process with CAP_AUDIT_CONTROL can change the ruleset or reset the lost counter, and neither is marked in the log.
